skill.displayName: Random Animal Generator – Free AI Tool to Discover Random Animals Online – API-powered
skill.summary: AI random animal generator — generate a hyper-realistic wildlife photo of any animal

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the random animal generator skill.
- Generate hyper-realistic wildlife photos of any animal via WeShop OpenAPI.
- Requires a user API key (WESHOP_API_KEY) for authentication.
- Supports optional reference image uploads and customizable description/scene.
- Batch image generation supported (1–16 images).
- Includes security guidelines to protect user API keys.
